ctx.x: Who was in the tuxedo brass band then?

The tuxedo man was, the way I was in it, was Southern Stan, Shots, and the Pajot, and the trumpets. And the little Aranza, the teal, and the. And August Russo, on Tramon, Sonny, on Tramon, and old man Taton. Old man Taton. I ain't talking about the E-says, or the saxophone tat. It's Paul.

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear of Papa called Zoost? Zoost. Yeah. Did you ever hear that nickname? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] And that's what they, what they used to call Sonny.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Because when Louis was getting ready to go away, we, we, we, we, we, we had a big thing at the time. Mm-hmm. And we'd say, well, I'm gonna play this one. It's this one, and I don't think I'll play any more. And they pulled Sonny with arm down while I'm in my office. They take your arm down, Papa, to see how I got it. I don't wanna play this when the boy plays it.
Did you ever hear of Papa called Zoost? Zoost. Yeah. Did you ever hear that nickname? Yeah.
And that's what they, what they used to call Sonny. They, you know what they used to call Celestan.
